title: Needs you
how: Only what is open for you, oldest first. Each item says what to do, links everything it needs, and gives my recommendation. It leaves this page once you have answered it here or done it.
Pick an answer under each item; a note is optional.
foot: One page, one link, kept current (his order of 2 November). The same list is kept as plain data beside it (items.json) for the advisor's checker.

sections.name: DECISION: Allow a free frame-timing tool (PresentMon) on your PC?
why: Order item 11 compares the big games' speed with ours; Intel's free PresentMon times their frames from outside, without opening their files.
It is MIT-licensed, stays on your PC and never ships, but it is not on the licence list, so it is yours to allow.
sections.recommendation: Yes: real frame times for the comparison, from outside the games, at no cost.
options: Yes, add it to the list (recommended)
